name: expat
input_api: XML_ParserCreateNS("UTF-8", ' '); XML_SetHashSalt(parser, fixed non-zero salt); element, namespace-declaration, character-data, comment and processing-instruction handlers; XML_Parse(parser, local bytes, size, XML_TRUE)
scope: Namespace-resolved XML 1.0 events from one in-memory document: document-order element and attribute expanded names, namespace declarations and URIs, maximum depth, and trimmed character-data runs between markup
family: expat (James Clark's expat, maintained as libexpat)
family_note: Independent of libxml2. Python's xml.parsers.expat / pyexpat, which produced the controls' expected outputs, bundles the same expat engine, so that oracle is same-family; the Go encoding/xml paths and a scratch libxml2 build gave the same summaries independently.
